references.text: Jesus sends out the twelve in Matthew's Gospel in a similar way as in Mark, which shows a pattern in how Jesus prepared his disciples for missionary work.
Luke's Gospel also describes how Jesus sends out the twelve and gives them power and authority over all demons and to heal diseases, which mirrors the event in Mark.
In Luke, seventy (or seventy-two) are sent out two by two, expanding on the principle Jesus established when he sent out the twelve in Mark.
